item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop a feedback-grounded audit of the twenty training users’ full-catalog recommendations: distinguish explicit rejection, choose-now feedback and missing item identity. Research title/description evidence for specificity, redundancy and stated prerequisites, with human calibration and abstention when evidence is missing. Ownership, compatibility and simulator traits must remain unknown unless explicitly supported; text similarity alone cannot establish usefulness.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic audit actionable relevance redundancy prerequisites user rejection feedback title description evidence abstention human calibration 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Connect the proposed exponential recency weighting to GRU4Rec’s actual training signals. Investigate per-position gradient magnitude and alignment, effective weighted sample size, and recurrent memory decay to distinguish helpful emphasis on recent supervision from loss of older useful signals. Investigate bounded, chunked full-catalog ranking audits and repeated diagnostic candidate draws to measure sampling uncertainty and popularity effects, plus controlled synthetic faults to test whether probes detect known failures. Preserve the pinned evaluator and splits; require actual generated-predictor parity, user-level uncertainty only with verified identities, and one checkpoint per category.","query":"recommender system diagnostic metric validation sampled ranking full catalog candidate sampling bias popularity uncertainty synthetic fault injection metamorphic testing 2024 2025 2026"}]}
